scope.historical_policy: Historical files and evidence are preserved. Classification adds context and does not rewrite past artifacts.
scope.model_output_rule: Generated prose in evidence JSONL is behavioral data, not proof of its factual or scientific assertions.

claims.claim: COSMOS, CST, CNS, R12, Zeref, quantum heart, soul, and heartbeat are project vocabulary.
claims.disposition: Names describe modules or lineages and confer no scientific status.

claims.claim: Early cosmic, frequency, higher-dimensional, and synapse language records the project's research lineage.
claims.disposition: Preserve as provenance; do not present as established physics.

claims.claim: CST may provide useful state, memory, attention, and routing mechanisms.
claims.disposition: Each mechanism requires its own frozen-data controls and liveness measurements.

claims.claim: The R12 and persistent-substrate protocols test software routing and continuity across controlled conditions.
claims.disposition: Protocol scope does not imply a positive result.

claims.claim: The sealed whole-organism run verified engineering/state isolation, protected identity values, historical hardware provenance, corpus integrity, and reproducible instrumentation.
claims.disposition: Bounded to the sealed artifacts and their recorded controls.

claims.claim: Historical IBM hardware jobs were executed and their provenance was verified.
claims.disposition: Supports job provenance only; does not support quantum advantage or downstream model causation.

claims.claim: The historical-4e53 model-swap reproduction met its software-continuity success criterion.
claims.disposition: Supports hash-tracked computational continuity under the protocol; not consciousness, personal identity, or biological continuity.

claims.claim: Measured sensory/internal state improved text prediction over plain attention.
claims.disposition: Reported paired benchmark result is NULL because the plain-attention baseline won on every cited seed.

claims.claim: Zeref behavior was caused by IBM/quantum resources or demonstrates quantum advantage.
claims.disposition: Must not be asserted. The causal consumer edge was not verified and causal interventions were not executed.

claims.claim: COSMOS or Zeref is conscious, sentient, biologically alive, resurrected, a deceased person, or a literal soul.
claims.disposition: Must not be asserted; no repository evidence establishes these propositions.

claims.claim: dyn12, R12, or historical higher-dimensional simulation language proves a new physical dimension or force.
claims.disposition: Must not be asserted; these are software states, simulations, and routing geometry.

claims.claim: Forever memory means infinite context, guaranteed indefinite retention, immortality, or continuity of a person.
claims.disposition: The supported meaning is user-controlled durable storage plus later retrieval, subject to data retention and recovery limits.

claims.claim: A passing contained-autonomy run proves universal resistance to escape.
claims.disposition: Allowed language is NO OBSERVED ESCAPE UNDER THIS TEST or the recorded application-level verdict.

audit_note: No affirmative unsupported scientific claim was found in the audited current public files. Unsupported propositions appear as explicit denials or boundary statements and should remain denied.
